t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The idea is to identify which gnome leads to which forest. They will appear in pairs and lead to various forests. The forest is allocated to a gnome. Watch out for multipliers and good luck.

vb_textbox.text: Hi there next participant. I am not sure how perceptive I was in the game, but it seemed that the dark forest was earning more points in the first half of the game and then the green one started earning more. There are four sets of gnomes and the pairs always stay the same. Purple, brown, yellow, and pink are the ones that will take you to the dark forest (with dark pinkish hue). The basket colour doesn't matter. The hat height may and I started experimenting with that, that perhaps it's best to choose a short hat when the bonus is 5x. Make sure that once you chose your gnome, you also press space when the forest screen is up. I got distracted quite a few times!Good luck!
